messages:
anita: Quick Friday micro-poll — if our hosted models were office coworkers, what would you nickname them? Drop 1-2 word names. No context needed, meme energy encouraged. :popcorn:
lee: `gpt-4o` = Desk Janitor (always cleaning up your buggy prompts) :broom:
sam: 4o = Overcaffeinated Grad Student :coffee:
maria: `redwood-small` = The Quiet Plant (needs watering but vibes) :seedling:
matthew: lol `gpt-4o` = That Person Who Forgets Mondays
lee: `opt-quant` = Tiny Napoleon (small but commanding) :military_medal:
anita: love these. ops-bot, record the winners? :robot_face:
ops-bot: noted — adding nicknames to the silly-names.txt archive (for posterity).
sam: Bonus round: give a Slack status for each model. I'll start: 4o = "crashing on warmstart" :sweat_smile:
maria: redwood-small = "photosynthesis in progress" :herb:
matthew: opt-quant = "puffed up with 4-bit confidence" :chart_with_upwards_trend:
lee: also, who would adopt `gpt-muse` as a desk mascot? I already bought a tiny beret.
anita: petition to make berets official swag. :raised_hands:
sam: +1 for berets, -1 for more swag storage problems
maria: question — are we allowed to use these nicknames in public docs? might confuse customers.
anita: not in docs, but absolutely in internal comms and standups. helps morale.
matthew: agreement. next week's icebreaker: model-as-serial-killer (jokes only) :grimacing:
lee: please no serial killer, but "model-as-80s-rock-star" yes. I call lead guitar.
anita: done. thanks all for the creative chaos. closing thread with a sticker: :party_parrot:
ops-bot: thread archived: casual/random-meta-2006 (for taxonomy, non-actionable)
